summary: AdServices returns Apple Ads attribution tokens for App Store download campaigns. It depends on Apple's attribution server and the App Store, and BifrOSt has no store or ad network, so there is no counterpart.

features.note: Token comes from Apple's attribution server for App Store campaigns; BifrOSt has no App Store attribution

features.apple: RESTful API call with the token (Apple Ads Campaign Management API)
features.note: Server-side Apple Ads service; no equivalent
Errors only exist for the token request above
